name: Clean-slate student, industry-leaning
description: No modules passed yet, no language constraint, sector='industry' (F56). Baseline case for module presence/layer/reason/area-CP, and also the one persona that proves F56's reordering is real: industry lean pulls the two software_methods_tools core modules ('Software Language Engineering', 'Software Architecture') ahead of the one theoretical_cs core module ('Foundations of Functional Programming'), flipping the track's own authored order. complementary/nice_to_have don't visibly reorder here (complementary is a tie -- both theoretical_cs; nice_to_have has only one module) but still get the correct per-module weight tag.
